exercises.instructions: Transform the following sentences between 'so … that' and 'such … that'.

questions.question: You are so intelligent. Transform to 'such … that'.
options: such an intelligent person
such a intelligent person
so an intelligent person
questions.explanation: Use 'such + an + adjective + noun'. 'Intelligent' starts with a vowel sound so use 'an'. 'Such a intelligent' uses wrong article. 'So an' mixes structures. 'Such … that' မှာ vowel sound စတဲ့ adjective တွေမှာ 'an' သုံးပါ။

questions.question: The man is so greedy that he never seems to stop eating. Transform to 'such … that'.
options: such a greedy man that he never seems to stop eating
so a greedy man that he never seems to stop eating
such greedy man that he never seems to stop eating
questions.answer: such a greedy man that he never seems to stop eating
questions.explanation: Use 'such + a + adjective + noun + that'. 'So a' is wrong structure. 'Such greedy man' is missing 'a'. 'Such … that' မှာ 'a/an' ပါအောင် သုံးပါ။
